claim: UPDATE acp_task_titles SET state='claimed',token=? WHERE task_id=? AND state='pending' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM managed_tasks t WHERE t.id=task_id AND t.provider=? AND t.project_id IS ? AND t.title='' AND t.archived=0)
owned: SELECT 1 FROM acp_task_titles WHERE task_id=? AND state='claimed' AND token=?
finish: UPDATE acp_task_titles SET state='done',token=NULL WHERE task_id=? AND state='claimed' AND token=?
write: UPDATE managed_tasks SET title=? WHERE id=? AND title='' AND archived=0
saveGenerated: INSERT INTO acp_task_title_sources(task_id, generated_title) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET generated_title=excluded.generated_title
saveAgent:
INSERT INTO acp_task_title_sources(task_id, agent_title)
SELECT t.id, @title FROM managed_tasks t LEFT JOIN acp_task_title_sources s ON s.task_id=t.id
WHERE t.id=@id AND t.provider=@engine AND t.project_id IS @projectId AND t.session_id=@sessionId AND t.archived=0
  AND (s.task_id IS NOT NULL OR (t.title='' AND @title IS NOT NULL))
ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET agent_title=excluded.agent_title
WHERE agent_title IS NOT excluded.agent_title
publishAgent:
UPDATE managed_tasks AS t SET title=COALESCE(s.agent_title, s.generated_title, '')
FROM acp_task_title_sources s WHERE t.id=? AND s.task_id=t.id
  AND t.title IS NOT COALESCE(s.agent_title, s.generated_title, '') RETURNING title
